body.x: Opcom Farm participated in ‘2018 CES SHOWSTOPPERS’ held in Las Vegas on 9th (U.S. time standard) and introduced GrowBox, an all-in-one cultivation system for growing vegetables at home.

Opcom Farm GrowBox is an all-in-one cultivation system, which allows users to grow vegetables all year around. GrowBox is provided with an OPCOM Smart Box, a smart multifunctional control system that can synchronize with all single devices, so it is possible to manage lighting and air pumps. Air and soil quality can be monitored, and high-intensity LED lighting generates full-color spectrum sunlight, helpful for plants to flourish, guaranteeing efficient growth of crops.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
